confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Nagarkot, a small hill village near Kathmandu with limited venue variety. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are moderately reliable from knowledge of Nepali price levels. Accommodation anchors are less certain because of the small local supply and seasonal swings. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced by search; I did not read the full page or the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Nepali price levels, using Kathmandu and Pokhara as reference points, with modest upward adjustment for the hillside tourist village's limited supply and resort-style lodging. No single named comparable city was used.
